section_summary.extract_value: This section describes the development and validation of a 5-item measure assessing participants' frequency of daily interactions with body-focused and non-body-focused others. The measure uses a 1-5 Likert scale and was factor analyzed to reveal two underlying factors: Exposure to Body-Focused Others (items about dieting, body image focus, and exercise) and Exposure to Non-Body-Focused Others (items about normal eating habits and low body image focus). The two factors were uncorrelated (r = .08) and explained 40.6% of total variance, with Cronbach's alphas ranging from .73 to .89 across study days.
